title: Nithin M
text:
I am an economist working at the intersection of macroeconomics, applied econometrics, and development.
I currently serve as Assistant Professor and Head, Department of Development Economics at Kerala Agricultural University. My work combines economic reasoning with empirical analysis, with particular interests in consumption dynamics, policy, and data-driven research.



Research
My current work focuses on macroeconomic behaviour, household consumption, and empirical methods for understanding economic change.


Teaching
I teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses in economics and applied policy.

title: Research
text:
Work in Progress

Does Sentiment Predict Consumption Growth of Indian Households?
Slides | Latest Version
This joint work with Dr. Siddhartha Chattopadhyay of IIT Kharagpur and Dr. Sohini Sahu of IIT Kanpur examines the role of sentiment in predicting household consumption growth in India.
Earlier versions of the paper were presented at the 19th Annual Conference at ISI Delhi and at the Workshop on Open Economy Macroeconomics and Economic Integration in Emerging Market Economies at the Centre for Development Studies, Thiruvananthapuram.
